name: FleiSync
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Flei123
description: Automatic server-side mod sync for the FleiLauncher: the server serves its mods over HTTP, the client syncs by just entering the server IP. No central service.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
